name: companion
description: Telegram channel for Ship Shape: a bot that bridges your Telegram DMs to one Claude Code session, with pairing and an allowlist. Replies render Markdown, SVG diagrams arrive as images, voice notes are transcribed with whisper.cpp when it is installed, and a notify tool sends news unasked. In the channel session it is your assistant over all your Claude Code sessions: it reads what each one is doing, talks to them, relays their questions, watches your PRs and pings you only when something needs you, and merges on your word behind Ship Shape's review gate and a confirm tap. Polls only in the session launched with --channels plugin:companion@shipshape (or the development flag), and stays inert everywhere else. Manage access with /companion:access and setup with /companion:configure. Adapted from the official Telegram channel plugin (Apache-2.0).
